data.long_meaning: The name Bhaiya is derived from the Sanskrit term 'bhai', which means 'brother'. This name is used to address an elder brother or a respected male figure. In Hindu mythology, Bhaiya is considered a protector and guardian. This name is deeply rooted in the cultural and spiritual traditions of India. The name Bhaiya carries the meaning “Elder brother, protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhaiya usually hope their child will grow to embody elder brother, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
